decisions.decision: GO — proceed to fix the Xcode 27 build failure
decisions.rationale: Total build stoppage; root cause proven; A5 validated end-to-end.

decisions.decision: ADR-001 — repair Bazel's driver binaries in place to restore LC_UUID
decisions.rationale: Same source/compiler/flags minus -Wl,-no_uuid; contained to Bazel's output base; self-disabling; empirically validated.

decisions.decision: ADR-002 — defer the Bazel 7/8 + Bzlmod migration
alternatives: Migrate now as part of this fix
decisions.rationale: Multi-day migration across rules_apple 1.1.3, rules_swift, 10 examples and integration tests; bundling it with an urgent unblock removes the working baseline needed to bisect.
